Integrate Memory Storage into Chat Flow

ac.title: Conversation context stored when conversation ends
ac.when: a conversation ends (user sends "thanks" or conversation times out)
ac.then: conversation context is stored via store_memory tool with: user_id, conversation summary, key decisions made, user preferences expressed, timestamp

ac.title: Memory stored with proper structure in agentic-memories
ac.then: the conversation is stored with proper structure and can be retrieved later

ac.title: System continues when agentic-memories is down (graceful degradation)
ac.then: the system continues without error, logs the failure, and stores memory in Redis temporarily for retry

ac.title: User informed when memory storage fails
ac.then: Annie continues working without memory context but informs the user: "Note: I'm having trouble accessing your memory right now, but I can still help."

ac.title: Memory includes decision context, preferences, and outcomes
ac.then: it includes: Decision context (what decision was made, options considered), User preferences (risk tolerance, priorities), Conversation flow (key topics discussed), Outcomes (if user provides feedback)

doc.title: Epic 3: Memory & Persistence - Technical Specification
doc.section: Overview, Data Flow, Memory Object Schema, agentic-memories API Contracts, store_memory MCP Tool Spec
doc.snippet: Defines Memory Object schema with decisions, preferences, topics. Specifies agentic-memories HTTP API (POST /memories). Details store_memory MCP tool with JSON-RPC 2.0 format. Storage flow: conversation end → retrieve history → LLM summarization → HTTP POST with fallback to Redis. Performance: <500ms p95 storage, <300ms p95 retrieval.

doc.title: Epic and Story Breakdown
doc.snippet: User story: As a user, I want Annie to remember our conversations and decisions, so that future advice is personalized based on my history. Acceptance criteria for memory storage, graceful degradation, conversation end detection, and performance (<500ms p95). Maps to Tasks 3.4, 3.5, 3.7.

doc.title: System Architecture Plan

doc.snippet: Backend API service architecture with FastAPI. MCP-based tool integration via Docker exec with stdio transport. Memory integration with agentic-memories service via HTTP client. State management patterns with Redis for fallback. Async/non-blocking operations throughout.

constraints.constraint: Use async/await patterns throughout. All memory operations must be non-blocking (asyncio.create_task for background storage).
Follow async context manager pattern (__aenter__, __aexit__) for MemoryClient resource cleanup (same as MCPClient and StateManager).
Custom exception hierarchy: MemoryClientError (base), MemoryNetworkError (network failures), MemoryAPIError (API errors). Follow MCPClient pattern.
Structured logging with duration tracking: logger.info("message", extra={"user_id": ..., "duration_ms": int((time.time() - start_time) * 1000)})
Performance target: <500ms p95 end-to-end storage (summarization ~2s + HTTP POST ~300ms + processing ~200ms). Storage must be async/non-blocking.
Graceful degradation: Continue chat functionality when agentic-memories down. Store in Redis fallback queue with 24h TTL. Retry every 5 minutes. Circuit breaker after 5 failures.
Conversation end detection: Farewell keywords ("thanks", "thank you", "bye", "goodbye" case-insensitive) OR 30-minute timeout since last message.
Memory size limits: Max 50 messages for summarization, max 10KB memory size (compress if larger with gzip), max 500 char summary, max 10 topics, max 5 decisions.
Use redis.asyncio.Redis for all Redis operations. Set 5s timeout to prevent hanging. Handle redis.exceptions.ConnectionError gracefully.
Reuse StateManager.get_conversation_history() to retrieve messages. Reuse LLMClient.chat_completion() for summarization. Follow established patterns.
Test coverage: >80% for memory modules (memory_client.py, memory.py, store_memory tool). Use pytest-asyncio, AsyncMock, respx for HTTP mocking.
Distributed lock (Redis) to prevent duplicate memory storage for same conversation_id. Use Redis SET with NX flag.

interface.name: StateManager.get_conversation_history
interface.signature: async def get_conversation_history(conversation_id: str, limit: int = 20) -> List[dict]
interface.usage: Call to retrieve last N messages from Redis for conversation summarization. Returns list of message dicts with role, content, timestamp.

interface.name: LLMClient.chat_completion
interface.signature: async def chat_completion(messages: List[dict], model: str = None) -> dict
interface.usage: Call with summarization prompt to generate Memory Object. Non-streaming call. Returns response dict with choices[0].message.content.

interface.name: MCPClient.call_tool
interface.signature: async def call_tool(tool_name: str, parameters: dict) -> dict
interface.usage: Reference for async tool calling patterns. store_memory tool will be called via MCP protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0) from backend.

interface.name: agentic-memories POST /memories
interface.signature: POST /memories Request: {"user_id": str, "memory": {Memory Object}} Response: {"status": "success", "memory_id": str, "stored_at": str}
interface.usage: MemoryClient.store_memory() sends HTTP POST to agentic-memories. Handle success (200), network errors (connection timeout), API errors (4xx/5xx).

interface.name: store_memory MCP Tool
interface.signature: {"name": "store_memory", "description": "Store conversation memory", "inputSchema": {"user_id": str, "conversation_summary": str, "decisions": array, "preferences": object, "topics": array, "sentiment": str}}
interface.usage: LLM can call this tool via function calling. Tool calls MemoryClient.store_memory() and returns success/failure in JSON-RPC format.

tests.standards: Use pytest for all tests with pytest-asyncio for async support. Mock external services (agentic-memories HTTP API with respx, LLM with AsyncMock). Test both success and failure paths comprehensively. Follow patterns from existing tests (test_llm_client.py, test_streaming_e2e.py). Target >80% code coverage. Tests in backend/tests/unit/ for unit tests, backend/tests/integration/ for integration tests, mcp_server/tests/ for MCP tool tests.

ideas.idea: Test MemoryClient.store_memory() with mocked httpx response (success 200). Test conversation end detection with farewell keywords and timeout. Test Memory Object creation from conversation history.
Test Memory Object schema validation (required fields, data types). Test agentic-memories HTTP API integration with respx mocking. Verify memory structure matches schema.
Test graceful degradation: mock httpx.NetworkError, verify Redis fallback queue stores memory. Test retry worker retrieves from queue and retries. Test circuit breaker after 5 failures.
Test user notification flag when memory storage fails. Verify chat continues without memory context. Test error logging includes user_id and context.

Test LLM summarization generates all required fields (decisions with options_considered/reasoning, preferences with risk_tolerance/priorities, topics, sentiment). Test fallback heuristic when LLM parsing fails.
Test performance: measure storage time with mocked agentic-memories (should be <500ms p95). Test async execution doesn't block chat response. Load test with 100 concurrent storage operations.
